title: DAG gate decoder
statement: Decode a Boolean list first as a gate kind and then, from the remaining bits, as a list of natural-number arguments, using the length of that remaining list as the recursion bound. If both decodings succeed, return the gate with that kind and argument list, together with the final unread bits; otherwise fail.
